trimmed_dict.title: Bobcat Beautification Month 2026
trimmed_dict.description:
Let’s Beautify Our Communities — Together

Bobcat Beautification Month is back, and it’s time for alumni everywhere to come together in service. Throughout the month, Bobcats across the country will be rolling up their sleeves, giving back locally, and making a positive environmental impact — one small action at a time.

Whether you join a network project, volunteer with a local organization, or take on a personal act of service, every effort counts. This month is about showing the power of the Bobcat community when we work together to make our neighborhoods cleaner, greener, and stronger.

⸻

🎁 Register by March 26 to Receive Your Bobcat Beautification Swag by Earth Day!

When you register early, you’ll receive a special sustainability-focused swag package to help you represent Bobcat pride while you serve:

🌱 100% Recyclable Bobcat Tote Bag
🌼 Seed Paper — plant it and watch something beautiful grow
🧴 Personal Hand Sanitizer — perfect for service projects on the go

These items are designed to celebrate sustainability while supporting your efforts to make a difference.

⸻

🌿 Need Ideas? Here’s How You Can Participate

You don’t need a large group to make an impact. Here are just a few ways you can give back:
• Join or organize a neighborhood or park clean-up
• Plant flowers, trees, or pollinator-friendly gardens
• Volunteer at a community garden or food pantry
• Pick up litter during a walk or hike
• Support a local environmental nonprofit
• Beautify a shared space at work, school, or in your neighborhood
• Recycle or donate gently used items
• Challenge friends or family to complete a service project with you

Big or small — every act helps create lasting change.

⸻

💚 Why We Beautify

Bobcat Beautification Month is about more than service — it’s about connection. It’s alumni coming together across cities and communities to leave places better than we found them and show what Bobcat pride looks like in action.

Register today, grab your swag, and join Bobcats everywhere in making an impact this spring.

If you have any questions, contact Jocelyn Johnson at kozlowsj@ohio.edu. If you need help with event registration, contact Advancement Events at eventsadv@ohio.edu.
